name: Pre-Matric Scholarship
benefit: > ₹ 150/- per month for a maximum of 10 months and annual ad hoc grant of ₹ 750/- in one go, maximum ₹ 2250/- annually.
_eligibility_text: 1. Native and studying in Uttar Pradesh. 1. Annual income of the parents/guardians of the students upto ₹ 2 Lakh. 1. Students studying in government schools, aided and recognized educational institutes (provided the availability of the budget).
